name: westwood_online_upgrade_progress_dialog_get_message_map
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeProgressDialog::GetMessageMap returns the progress dialog MFC message-map object.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x442260 validates a leaf thiscall const accessor that returns g_WestwoodOnlineUpgradeProgressDialog_MessageMap.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_progress_dialog_get_message_map_smoke verifies the accessor returns WestwoodOnlineUpgradeProgressDialog::messageMap, the map points at the progress message entry array, and the entry array contains the sentinel-only MFC map used by this raw DlgProc-backed progress dialog.
